blocks.text: Requirements aam taur par do qismon mein taqseem hoti hain: functional aur non-functional requirements.

blocks.title: Functional requirements
blocks.text: Functional requirements nizam ke khaas rawayye ya kaam bayan karti hain: nizam ko kya karna chahiye, jin mein woh kaam, khidmat aur functions shamil hain jo use anjaam dene hain aur users ya doosre nizamon ke saath us ka taamul.

items: User registration: users (students, faculty) register kar ke account bana sakte hain.
Book borrowing: users kitabein dhoond kar udhaar le sakte hain.
Book return: users udhaar li kitabein wapas kar sakte hain.
Inventory management: librarians kitabein jor, badal aur hata sakte hain.
Notification: nizam wapsi ki tareekh aur der ho chuki kitabon ki ittila bhejta hai.

blocks.title: Non-functional requirements
blocks.text: Non-functional requirements nizam ki maiyar ki khusoosiyat, kaarkardagi ke mayaar aur pabandiyan tay karti hain. Yeh batati hain ke nizam koi kaam kaise karta hai, yeh nahi ke kya karta hai, aur usability, reliability, performance aur security ko shamil karti hain.

items: Performance: 1000 tak ek waqt ke users ko baghair sust hue sambhalna.
Usability: aasani se samajh aane wala aur chalne wala interface.
Security: user data encrypted aur mehfooz authentication.
Scalability: zyada users aur zyada kitabon tak barhna.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi requirement batati hai ke nizam ko kaise kaam karna chahiye (MCQ 2)? Functional aur non-functional requirements mein farq bataiye (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: Non-functional requirements, option (b). Functional requirements batati hain ke nizam ko kya karna hai (kitab udhaar aur wapas, users ki registration); non-functional batati hain ke kitna acha karna hai (1000 users sambhalna, 99.9% dastiyabi, encryption, aasan navigation).

items: Functional: nizam kya karta hai (library: registration, udhaar, wapsi, inventory, ittila).
Non-functional: kitna acha karta hai (performance, usability, reliability, security, scalability); Table 1.1 muwazna karti hai.
